build_system: Composer for PHP dependencies. No npm build needed for backend-only changes. Migrations run via php artisan migrate.

verification_instructions: 1. Run php artisan migrate to apply new migrations. 2. Start the dev server with php artisan serve. 3. Manually test each feature through the browser: register/login flows, settings pages, session tracking. 4. Check Laravel logs at storage/logs/laravel.log for errors.
environment_constraints: This is a local Windows worktree. Database is MySQL 8.0+. Laravel session driver is 'database' (sessions table already exists). Never restart any external services. Auth uses standard Laravel Auth facade with LoginController at app/Http/Controllers/Auth/LoginController.php.
contribution_requirements: No CONTRIBUTING.md or AGENTS.md found. Follow Laravel 12 conventions. Use Schema::hasTable() guards in migrations since password_reset_tokens table already exists. Match existing code style: controller methods use type-hinted Request, models use fillable arrays, Blade views use inline CSS with custom properties (--ink, --cream, --trust-blue, --coral, --gold, --mint).
key_patterns: Controllers return view() or redirect() with withErrors/with() flash messages. Notifications extend Illuminate\Notifications\Notification with via(['database','mail']) and toMail() returning MailMessage with ->view(). Services are plain PHP classes in app/Services/. Middleware registered in bootstrap/app.php or Kernel (check both). User model has role enum (student/tutor/admin/parent) and helper methods isAdmin(), isTutor(), isStudent(), isParent(). Existing OtpService pattern: generate 6-digit code, store in DB with expiry, send via Mail facade.
